purpose: Document first-party discovery, official local parcel GIS routes, bounded access attempts, safe-field handling, and uncertainty.
assessment: The City of Albuquerque publishes a local citywide parcel GIS/download page, an Advanced Map Viewer, and an official ArcGIS REST service listing city- and county-maintained parcel layers. The direct REST and archive retrievals were attempted but timed out or failed to complete from this environment; no feature response or polygon is claimed.
registryAssessment: registryFound=true is supported by the official City of Albuquerque local GIS parcel download/viewer and its official local ArcGIS service. It does not establish complete, current, or ownership-level cadastral coverage.
